name: api-verity-lab
summary: API contract governance across seven protocols: diff, breaking-change rules, runtime drift, performance budgets and agent-tool governance under one contract model and one result format.

commands.name: agent-setup
commands.summary: tell the coding agents working in this repository that this tool exists

commands.name: app
commands.summary: read the contract out of an application object and check it

commands.name: audit
commands.summary: export the hash-chained audit log, or verify an exported one

commands.name: baseline
commands.summary: measure latency percentiles and store them for later comparison

commands.name: breaking
commands.summary: classify those changes against the rule catalogue and fail on the breaking ones

commands.name: budget
commands.summary: check observed calls against a declared call budget

commands.name: capture
commands.summary: record real traffic through a proxy, into a HAR corpus

commands.name: changelog
commands.summary: a release note for a version bump, in markdown or HTML

commands.name: config
commands.summary: validate or show the project config

commands.name: coverage
commands.summary: which operations and statuses a run actually exercised

commands.name: diff
commands.summary: every semantic change between two contracts, with a stable id each

commands.name: digest
commands.summary: one contract-health document per team, from a sweep artifact

commands.name: drift
commands.summary: the declared contract against a live service, a recorded corpus or an MCP server

commands.name: evidence
commands.summary: assemble result artifacts into a dated, checksummed evidence pack

commands.name: explain
commands.summary: explain one rule: what it means, why, and how to change its severity

commands.name: export
commands.summary: write a portable .apiverity bundle with checksums

commands.name: federation
commands.summary: what a subgraph change does to the composed graph

commands.name: freeze
commands.summary: emergency stop: refuse deployments and approvals until lifted

commands.name: ghosts
commands.summary: find routes the contract no longer declares that the server still answers

commands.name: graph
commands.summary: which contract in a tree reads whose schemas

commands.name: import-rules
commands.summary: read a Spectral ruleset and report what migrating it would cost

commands.name: infer
commands.summary: draft a contract from recorded traffic, labelled as a draft

commands.name: init
commands.summary: detect this project's contracts and write .apiverity.yaml

commands.name: mcp-inventory
commands.summary: list the MCP servers this machine is configured to reach, and flag unapproved ones

commands.name: mcp-lock
commands.summary: write or check mcp.lock, a reviewed baseline for an MCP tool surface

commands.name: mock
commands.summary: serve a deterministic mock of a contract, with optional misbehaviour

commands.name: monitor
commands.summary: run a command on a schedule and report what changed since last time

commands.name: notify
commands.summary: route a result artifact's findings to the teams they concern

commands.name: plugins
commands.summary: list installed plugins across the six entry-point groups

commands.name: regression
commands.summary: measure again and fail when latency or error rate regressed past a tolerance

commands.name: replay
commands.summary: replay a sanitized traffic corpus, dry-run by default

commands.name: report
commands.summary: render a result bundle: terminal, markdown, HTML, JUnit, SARIF, oasdiff's own JSON shape, a pull request comment, or an OWASP mapping

commands.name: rules
commands.summary: the whole rule catalogue, with the severities this run would apply

commands.name: self-test
commands.summary: check this installation can load, diff and classify a bundled fixture

commands.name: serve
commands.summary: serve a bundle over HTTP for local viewing

commands.name: server-db
commands.summary: backup/restore/export/import a server database

commands.name: sweep
commands.summary: every contract in a tree, with an owner and a verdict for each

commands.name: test
commands.summary: generate cases from the schema and run them against a live service

commands.name: validate
commands.summary: load a contract, report what is wrong with the document itself

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: check a bundle against its own SHA256SUMS

commands.name: watch
commands.summary: re-run a command whenever the files it names change

commands.name: workflow
commands.summary: run a multi-step workflow manifest, or infer a draft from a contract
